note: Attacker-controlled 16-bit tag word read from the VC-5 datablock; here it is 0x6000 (LargeCodeblock) with no preceding SubbandNumber tag in the stream.
The 0x6000 tag matches VC5Tag::LargeCodeblock, so the chunk is dispatched to parseLargeCodeblock() without any prior SubbandNumber/Quantization/LowpassPrecision tag having been seen.
The chunk payload stream is passed into parseLargeCodeblock(); mVC5.iSubband, mVC5.lowpassPrecision and mVC5.quantization were never assigned by any tag.

mVC5.iSubband is an uninitialized ushort16 member (no SubbandNumber tag was present), so its indeterminate value is used to index the 10-element subband_wavelet_index array, causing an out-of-bounds read.
The same uninitialized iSubband value is used to index subband_band_index; with a value >= numSubbands (10) this is a second out-of-bounds read (crash sink).
